emotionAdviserModal.title: Emotion adviser
emotionAdviserModal.intro1: Pause for a moment. Take a few slow breaths in and out. Feel yourself — here and now.
emotionAdviserModal.intro2: Try to answer a few simple questions:
questions: What does my body feel like? Is there tension, pain, lightness?
What thoughts are spinning in my head? What am I thinking about?
What triggered this state? An event, a person, a memory?
If my emotion were a color, a sound, or a temperature — what would it be?
